will_publish.lens: W-PD-1(a)+(b) — the interval from public disclosure to exploitation collapsed to days or hours across five unrelated products in one week, and NCSC-CH put five of them in front of Swiss operators inside the same week

W-PD-1(a)+(b) — two espionage toolsets shipped kernel-mode rootkits in one week whose function is to edit what the operating system reports to the defender's own tools, and one rode an exploited zero-day patched on 11 August

W-PD-1(b) — four unrelated intrusions and one research publication converge on corrupting the evidence a responder reconstructs afterwards, rather than evading the sensor in the moment; two of the week's victims independently demonstrated the defensive mirror

W-PD-1(b) — in every European public-sector and critical-infrastructure disclosure this week the compromised party and the party owing the notification were different organisations; distinct from W32's government-infrastructure roll-call
W33 CVE trajectory against first coverage
W-PD-1(c) — the fourth passkey thread the prior weekly deliberately dropped for want of sourcing is now documented, and it resolved; corrects this store's own picture
W-PD-1(b) — three independent developer-credential findings this week each show an estate auditing the wrong artefact, the wrong incident class, or the wrong scope
Cl0p PTC Windchill campaign status — first victim corroboration and first post-exploitation detail

the clock the prior weekly recorded as forthcoming started, with no transition period
